engagement_context.company_size: HarborCart is a fictional online retailer with 120 employees and two warehouses.
engagement_context.departments: Customer support, development, finance and warehouse operations.
engagement_context.infrastructure_summary: A public e-commerce web application and customer REST APIs handle account login, order tracking and refunds against a private SQL database.
engagement_context.network_architecture: Third-party logistics vendors use VPN access to warehouse networks. Vendor access reviews are infrequent.
engagement_context.data_storage: Customer addresses and order histories are stored in SQL. Images and backups use cloud object storage. Backup restoration tests are not documented. Payment processing is outsourced; no full card numbers are stored.
engagement_context.customer_touchpoints: Customer accounts, order tracking, password reset and courier REST API integrations.

engagement_context.company_size: Meadow Clinic is a fictional practice with 35 employees.
engagement_context.infrastructure_summary: An internal patient-record application uses a local database. Some reception staff share logins.
engagement_context.network_architecture: A private clinic LAN has no public web application, no REST API and no vendor VPN.
engagement_context.data_storage: Patient records and appointment information are stored on a local server. Backups exist, but restore testing is undocumented.
engagement_context.customer_touchpoints: Appointments are arranged by phone and at reception.

engagement_context.company_size: ForgeWorks is a fictional manufacturer with two factories.
engagement_context.infrastructure_summary: Legacy industrial devices and PLCs operate production lines. Some devices are unsupported and cannot be patched routinely.
engagement_context.network_architecture: Vendors connect through a VPN. Shared vendor accounts are used and access reviews are infrequent. Office and industrial devices share a flat network.
engagement_context.data_storage: Production recipes and equipment configuration files are held on local engineering workstations.
engagement_context.customer_touchpoints: Orders are handled by phone; no public application or customer API is operated.

engagement_context.company_size: A fictional small organization with eight staff.

engagement_context.infrastructure_summary: No public web application, no cloud object storage, no customer API and no SQL database are operated.
engagement_context.network_architecture: No VPN or remote access is provided.
